text: At its meeting on March 9, 2023, the Toronto Investment Board ("Board") discussed the background of the current Asset Mix contained in the current Council-adopted Investment Policy (Attachment 1). The Investment Consultant (Aon) suggested providing a historical background review of the work completed on Asset Mix since the creation of the Toronto Investment Board ("Board") in 2017. Attachment 2 provides a summary of the multiple reviews and the results to date. Full reports and presentations can be found by following the links in the Decision History section below.
The Toronto Investment Board received the report (May 27, 2023) from the Director, Capital Markets for information.
